scenarios.title: Signed-in user opens the board
preconditions: An approved test account is signed in on the dashboard.
given: An approved test account is signed in on the dashboard.
when: The user opens Board from project navigation.
expectedResults: Selecting Board from project navigation opens /board with the observed title and heading.

evidence.detail: After sign-in, selecting the Board navigation link opened /board with title Board — ZincTM.
The authenticated board page title and Board heading were observed.

openQuestions: Which approved product requirement defines the intended authenticated route to the board?

scenarios.title: Board presents the observed defect status columns
preconditions: An approved test account is signed in and the board is open.
given: An approved test account is signed in on the board.
then: The board presents the "new", "open", "in progress", "fixed", "retest", and "closed" status columns.
expectedResults: All six status columns observed during exploration are presented without asserting account-specific card counts or contents.

evidence.detail: The six status columns were visible on the authenticated board.
Each status column and its observed label is documented in the element inventory.

openQuestions: Are all six columns required for every project and user role?

scenarios.title: Board presents an empty defect filter
preconditions: An approved test account is signed in and the board is open with no filter text entered.
given: An approved test account is signed in on the board.
when: The user views the board before entering a filter.
then: The board presents an empty "Filter defects" field.
The field shows the placeholder "Filter by key, summary or label…".
expectedResults: The observed enabled filter field is initially empty and displays its observed placeholder.

evidence.detail: The enabled board-filter textbox was empty and exposed the label Filter defects and the recorded placeholder.

openQuestions: What matching behavior, clear behavior, and no-results response should be expected when users enter a filter?

scenarios.title: Unauthenticated visitor is redirected from the board
preconditions: The browser has no authenticated session.
given: The browser has no authenticated session.
when: The visitor opens the board directly.
then: The sign-in page is displayed at "/login".
The page title is "Sign in — ZincTM".
expectedResults: Direct navigation to /board without an authenticated session redirects to the observed sign-in page.

evidence.detail: Direct navigation without an authenticated session ended at /login.
The unauthenticated redirect to the sign-in page was observed; authenticated board state was inspected separately.

openQuestions: Is redirecting every unauthenticated board visit to /login the intended access-control behavior?

coverageGaps: No board-specific product requirements or acceptance criteria were supplied; these cases characterize observed behavior and have no requirement IDs.
Filter matching, clearing, no-results behavior, and boundary inputs were not explored and are not asserted.
Card navigation, status transitions, drag-and-drop, permissions, and persistence were not explored.
Account-specific card identifiers, contents, and counts are intentionally not asserted.
